rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unexpected harmful accident, especially when it is not specifically a vehicle crash.

example.english: He slipped while walking; it was a real accident.
example.traditional: 佢行路跣親，真係一場意外。
example.jyutping: keoi5 haang4 lou6 sin2 can1 zan1 hai6 jat1 coeng4 ji3 ngoi6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a crash or collision involving a vehicle or other transport.

example.english: The car was in an accident yesterday.
example.jyutping: kam4 jat6 gaa3 ce1 ceot1 zo2 ce1 wo6
